Astŭrĭa , ae, f.
I. A province in Hispania Tarraconensis, Plin. 4, 20, 34, § 112; cf. Mann. Hispan. p. 353 sq.—Hence, Astŭ-rĭcus , a, um, adj., Asturian: “gens,” Plin. 8, 42, 67, § 166 ; so Sil. 16, 584.—
II. Subst.: Astŭrĭca , ae, f., the capital of Asturia, on the river Astura, now Astorga: “Asturica urbs magnifica,” Plin. 3, 3, 4, § 28 ; cf. Mann. Hispan. p. 355.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
